llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match the described DigitalOcean monitoring purpose, but the registry metadata claims no required binaries or credentials even though the SKILL.md and script require python3 and a DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN — this inconsistency is concerning and should be resolved before trusting the skill.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and scripts implement exactly what the description says: listing droplets and fetching CPU/memory/disk/bandwidth metrics from api.digitalocean.com. That capability legitimately requires a DigitalOcean API token and python3 to run. However, the registry metadata provided with the skill lists no required env vars, binaries, or primary credential; this mismatch is unexpected and reduces trust.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions tell the agent to run the included Python script and to set DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN. The script only reads the DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN environment variable and calls DigitalOcean API endpoints (api.digitalocean.com). There is no evidence in the visible code of reading unrelated files, other environment variables, or sending data to third-party endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided and the skill is instruction + script only. That is low-risk from an install perspective because nothing arbitrary is downloaded or executed automatically by an installer. The script is included in the package and runs with the user's python3 binary.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requesting a DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN is proportional to the stated purpose. The concern is that the registry metadata claims no required environment variables or primary credential while the SKILL.md and script clearly require DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN and SKILL.md metadata marks it as primaryEnv. This inconsistency could cause users to miss that a secret is required or to grant a token without noticing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request elevated or persistent platform privileges. always is false and there are no install hooks or modifications to other skills or system-wide settings in the provided files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says (query DigitalOcean monitoring endpoints) and the included script reads only DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN and calls api.digitalocean.com. However, the registry metadata incorrectly declares no required binaries or credentials while SKILL.md and the script require python3 and a DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN. Before installing: (1) confirm the registry metadata is updated or otherwise acknowledge that you must provide a DigitalOcean token and python3; (2) review the full script (including the truncated part) to ensure there are no unexpected network endpoints or hardcoded hosts; (3) create a token with the minimum permissions needed (use a read-only/monitoring-scoped token if possible), store it in a secure secret manager (avoid plaintext files where feasible), and rotate it if you stop using the skill; and (4) run the script in a low-privilege environment first to inspect its outputs. If you want, provide the full (untruncated) scripts/do_metrics.py so I can re-check the remaining code for any hidden behavior.
